project_type: Python robotics reliability platform — forge_core library + CLI scripts + ROS 2 nodes
build_system: setuptools via pyproject.toml, pip install -e '.[dev]' for dev deps, pip install -e '.[ml]' for torch
test_framework: pytest >= 7.0 with pytest-timeout, markers: unit (no ROS), integration (ROS). All 215 current tests are unit tests that pass without ROS.
verification_instructions: 1. Run python3 -m pytest tests/ -v and confirm all tests pass. 2. Run python3 scripts/forge_doctor.py for health check. 3. For regression specifically: python3 scripts/forge_regression.py --help should work.
snapshot_or_generated_files: baselines/manipulation-v1.json is generated by forge_regression.py --create-baseline and committed to repo. No other generated files are checked in.
environment_constraints: MUJOCO_GL=egl for headless rendering in CI. No ROS dependency in forge_core/. PyTorch optional (only for learned policy features). No GPU required. WSL environment: absolute paths use /root/forge on Linux side.
contribution_requirements: forge_core/ must have ZERO ROS imports. YAML-driven configuration. Tests in tests/unit/ and tests/integration/. CLI scripts in scripts/. File-based storage (JSON) for state like baselines, experiments, registry.
key_patterns: 1. File-based JSON storage: see ExperimentTracker (forge_core/experiment.py) and ModelRegistry (forge_core/model_registry.py) — single JSON file per entity or collection. 2. CLI scripts: argparse with sys.path injection at top (see forge_eval.py, forge_chaos.py, forge_registry.py). 3. Tests: class-based grouping, tmp_path fixtures, _project_root sys.path injection, ~15-25 tests per module. 4. Dataclasses for structured results: see EvalResult, CriterionResult in evaluator.py. 5. Config: YAML files in config/ loaded via forge_core/config.py load_yaml(). 6. PROJECT_ROOT from forge_core.config for all path resolution.
relevant_files: forge_core/evaluator.py — EvalResult dataclass and to_dict() method, the output format regression checks against
forge_core/runner.py — run_suite() function to run multiple tasks, format_suite_summary() for display
forge_core/task.py — load_suite() to load suite YAML, list_tasks()
forge_core/experiment.py — ExperimentTracker pattern to follow for file-based JSON storage
forge_core/config.py — PROJECT_ROOT, load_yaml(), YAML config loading
scripts/forge_eval.py — CLI pattern: argparse, sys.path, policy creation, suite running
tasks/suites/manipulation-v1.yaml — the eval suite (3 tasks: pick_red_cube, pick_blue_cube, pick_red_cube_spread)
config/training.yaml — YAML config pattern to follow for regression.yaml
tests/unit/test_experiment.py — test pattern: class-based, tmp_path, sample helpers
tests/unit/test_model_registry.py — test pattern for registry-like module
tests/unit/test_evaluator.py — test pattern with sim fixture
pyproject.toml — project deps and pytest config
docs/setup.md — setup and CLI documentation pattern
README.md — status, features, structure, test count
directory_structure: forge_core/ — core Python library (no ROS). scripts/ — CLI entry points. tests/unit/ — 15 unit test files (215 tests). tests/integration/ — 1 acceptance test file. config/ — YAML configs (default.yaml, training.yaml). tasks/ — task YAML definitions. tasks/suites/ — suite YAML files. docs/ — architecture.md, setup.md. simulation/ — MuJoCo models, worlds, scenarios. faults/ — fault profile YAML files. experiments/ — experiment tracking JSON. registry/ — model registry JSON. runs/ — recorded run outputs. models/ — saved .pt model files. .github/workflows/ — to be created for CI.
